items.briefing:
Australian security leaders are increasingly concerned about AI governance, with new reports showing security chiefs are more worried than their own staff about managing AI risks and compliance obligations. This is particularly relevant for training organisations handling sensitive student data, as AI tools become more embedded in daily operations.

On the platform side, Twitch (owned by Amazon) has been found using people's live streams to train AI without clear consent — a reminder to review what data your organisation shares with third-party platforms. **Practical tip:** Check the terms and conditions of any AI or streaming tools your organisation uses to understand how your data may be used.
